design.accounting: UNADJUSTED units; split before distribution; dividends earned by prior holdings, ex-date CLOSE reinvestment; exit-open entitlement retained as cash; no entry-exdate entitlement
design.beta_control: descriptive OLS weekly-minus-BIL on SPY-minus-BIL per horizon/cost; no trade weights or model prediction derived
design.daily_wealth: initial NAV, every held-session CLOSE, terminal exit OPEN; mixed daily paths weighted before recomputing MDD
design.dividend_payment_dates: UNKNOWN: economic ex-date reinvestment, not verified executable payment-date cash
design.entry: first common observed SPY/IEF/BIL US session OPEN strictly after T
design.exit: OPEN after N complete common observed sessions; same entry and exit for every benchmark
design.intervals: 1000 paired annual-cutoff resamples, fixed seed 20261009, percentile 2.5/97.5; descriptive only, overlapping 24m/year regimes invalidate independent-bet interpretation
limitations: current corrected/backfilled vendor vintages, not archived quotes
normal-session timing; halts and half-days not exhaustively audited
USD only; no FX or taxes
fund expenses embedded; trading costs assumed
17 annual clusters, overlapping horizons and common macro shocks
fixed allocation controls do not demonstrate optimal asset allocation
no return edge, risk edge or principle promotion from sample averages alone
design.old_rules: copy WEEKLY_SWITCH and FIXED_ENTRY_CHOICE results only; no new signal, rerun, parameter change or sample filtering
design.parity_requirement: all old SPY/BIL and 50/50 returns/MDD match under both costs and every horizon; fail whole run on timing discrepancy
design.rebalancing: NONE; fixed initial buy-and-hold weights, drifting thereafter; not annual-rebalanced allocation or CAGR
design.residuals: paired net-return difference from each specified same-timing benchmark; not estimated causal alpha

honesty_note: Old 102 cash/sell records and summary were inspected before this new comparator design; this lock cannot establish blindness.
